vectors.vector: GENUINE signature, deadline refreshed AND nonce advanced to the sender's current one

vectors.vector: GENUINE signature, deadline refreshed but the spent nonce reused
vectors.why: the spent nonce is refused before the signature is even looked at, so a consumed attestation has two independent reasons to die

vectors.vector: GENUINE signature, refreshed deadline, lifted to the attacker wallet
